'''Tamana''' is a woman who works in a hooper's shop on [[Almoth Plain]].
== History ==
She is part of the [[eyes-and-ears]] network of [[Nadira]] Sedai of the [[Blue Ajah]], and tries to pass messages from Nadira to others when [[Falme]] is taken by the [[Seanchan]].<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
